units.source_text: 薰中纳言的随从中有几个地位不甚高贵的人，夹杂在人丛中暗中观看这盛况，

en.t: Among the attendants of Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, were several men of rather modest rank, who mingled with the crowd and secretly watched the splendid scene,

units.source_text: 回到三条宫邸之后叹息道：“我们这位大人为何如此老实，

en.t: and after returning to the Sanjo palace, they sighed, “Why is our lord so painfully honest,

units.source_text: 不肯去当左大臣家的女婿呢？

en.t: and why will he not become the son-in-law of the Minister of the Left?

units.source_text: 孤居独处多乏味啊！”

en.t: How dull it is to live all alone!”

units.source_text: 他们在中门旁边发牢骚，薰中纳言听到了觉得可笑。

en.t: They grumbled beside the middle gate, and Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, heard them and found it amusing.

units.source_text: 大约此时夜色已深，他们都想睡觉，

en.t: By then the night was probably deep, and they all wanted to sleep,

units.source_text: 刚才看见匂亲王的随从人等得意扬扬地醉饱了美酒佳肴而躺在一处休息，

en.t: for they had just seen Prince Niou's attendants, pleased and proud, lying together to rest after filling themselves with fine wine and delicacies,

units.source_text: 他们心中不胜羡慕吧。

en.t: so they must have envied them greatly.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言走进自己室中，躺着想道：“当新女婿多难为情啊！

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, went into his own room, lay down, and thought, “How embarrassing it is to be a new son-in-law!

units.source_text: 本来是至亲至眷，却神气活现地出来坐席，

en.t: One is already among close kin, yet comes out looking so self-important to take a seat,

units.source_text: 在灯烛辉煌之下举杯敬酒，匂亲王倒对付得彬彬有礼呢。”

en.t: and raises a cup to offer wine under brilliant lamplight; Prince Niou handled it with real grace and courtesy.”

units.source_text: 他赞佩匂亲王态度漂亮。

en.t: He admired Prince Niou's elegant bearing.

units.source_text: 又想：“的确不错，我倘有个心爱的女儿，

en.t: Then he thought, “It is true enough; if I had a beloved daughter,

units.source_text: 除了嫁给这匂亲王以外，即使宫中也不愿让她去。

en.t: I would not want to give her to anyone but this Prince Niou, not even to the palace.

units.source_text: 世人谁都想把女儿嫁给匂亲王，

en.t: Everyone in the world wants to marry a daughter to Prince Niou,

units.source_text: 但他们又说：‘还是源中纳言更好。’

en.t: yet they also say, ‘Still, Genji the Middle Counselor is better.’

units.source_text: 这句话已变成常谈。

en.t: Those words have already become common talk.

units.source_text: 可见世人对我的评判不坏。

en.t: That shows that the world's judgment of me is not bad.

units.source_text: 只是我太乖僻，有些老气横秋。”

en.t: It is only that I am too eccentric and somewhat old-fashioned.”

units.source_text: 想到这里，颇有骄矜之感。

en.t: Thinking this, he felt a considerable sense of pride.

units.source_text: 又想：“今上曾经表示欲将二公主降嫁与我，

en.t: Then he thought, “The reigning Emperor once showed a wish to marry the Second Princess down to me,

units.source_text: 如果真有此意，我只管如此踌躇不决，如何是好？

en.t: and if he truly means it, what am I to do if I go on hesitating like this?

units.source_text: 这虽然是脸上增光的事，但不知究竟如何。

en.t: Though it would bring me honor, I do not know how it would really turn out.

units.source_text: 又不知二公主相貌生得怎样，

en.t: Nor do I know what the Second Princess looks like,

units.source_text: 如果很像已故的大女公子，我真是不胜欣喜了。”

en.t: but if she greatly resembles the late eldest princess, I would truly be overjoyed.”

units.source_text: 他有这种想法，可知毕竟不是全然无意的。

en.t: Since he had such thoughts, it is clear that he was not entirely without interest after all.

units.source_text: 照例不能入睡，寂寞无聊，

en.t: As usual he could not sleep, and feeling lonely and bored,

units.source_text: 便走进一个比别人更多怜爱的侍女按察君房中，在那里睡到天明。

en.t: he went into the room of Azechi no Kimi, a lady-in-waiting he favored more than the others, and slept there until dawn.

units.source_text: 其实即使睡到日高三丈，也不会有人讥议，

en.t: In truth, even if he had slept until the sun was high, no one would have criticized him,

units.source_text: 他却慌慌张张，急忙起身。

en.t: yet he became flustered and hurriedly got up.

units.source_text: 按察君颇有不满之色，吟诗云：

en.t: Azechi no Kimi looked rather displeased and recited a poem:
